meta.name: agentic-delegation
meta.description: Plan who does each step of a task in this repo, on which model, at which effort: Haiku or Sonnet subagents for search, recon, and log-reading; code edits on Opus 5.5; start at medium effort and escalate on evidence (high, then xhigh, then Fable 5.1 for one stuck task); the orchestrator keeps design, security-sensitive edits, verification, and the commit. Use at the start of any task that spans more than one file or needs research or CI-log triage, whenever a fix keeps failing at the current effort, and whenever you are about to spawn a subagent or pick a model or effort level — even if nobody says 'delegate'.
